sources.adoption: Combine compatible responsibilities for small work; specialize only when actual scale needs it.
sources.transfer_limits: Worker counts are this preset's bounded policy, not Basecamp headcount advice or a performance guarantee. No fixed human work cadence is copied.

sources.adoption: Group work around independently finishable outcomes and integrate their artifacts.
sources.transfer_limits: The host must establish real dependency and file boundaries. A pair of task labels does not establish useful parallelism.

sources.adoption: Make scope and stop conditions explicit; producers own basic behavioral checks.
sources.transfer_limits: Scope reductions need an explicit requirement decision. They cannot silently remove user acceptance or excuse a failed check.

sources.adoption: Review evidence for correctness and maintainability; distinguish required corrections from optional polish.
sources.transfer_limits: Google's peer review guidance informs quality checks. Hakengaisya's direct-supervisor acceptance and context separation are its own authority rules.

exclusions: Production deployment and live data migration
More than two independent implementation streams
Unresolved product discovery or aesthetic acceptance
required_inputs: Explicit constraints and actual tool requirements
One coherent component or two independent components and an integration contract
Declared file ownership and input/output references

responsibilities: The existing host owns scope, model fit, direct acceptance and escalation.
A producer combines local design, implementation, relevant developer checks and a usable handover.
Integration reuses a qualified producer from the declared pool; the supervisor independently checks the combined result.
Specialist findings can support review but never replace the responsible supervisor's decision.

variants.reason: One coherent deliverable has one producer and acceptance by the existing supervisor; no extra administrative packet is needed.
Two independently testable components with disjoint writes permit a bounded parallel pool, followed by integrated delivery. Qualification and overhead may still favor one reused producer.

multi-stream.excluded_reason: This bounded-task preset stops at two implementation streams. Larger projects need explicit inter-stream interfaces and another reviewed project preset.

large.excluded_reason: A multi-team organization needs phase, integration and supervisor-capacity rules outside this bounded-task contract. Do not expand this preset by adding titles.

stages.entry: The user outcome, constraints, baseline behavior and material unknowns are understood.
stages.outputs: A reviewed draft brief with concrete checks, bounded components and required tools.
stages.exit_evidence: The graph and applicability checks pass; model/tool access and any constrained budget are supported before dispatch.

stages.entry: A current assignment names the producer, direct supervisor, permitted model/route and exact write scope.
stages.outputs: Every contracted component artifact and the relevant behavioral/regression evidence.
stages.exit_evidence: The assigned owner submits the current attempt with inspectable output and check references.

stages.entry: For the parallel variant, both component gates are accepted; micro work performs integration inside its coherent delivery.
stages.outputs: A combined usable result, compatibility checks and handover details requested by the task.
stages.exit_evidence: The terminal result depends on all component outputs and has its own observed checks; an existing qualified producer performs this work.

stages.entry: A submitted result and its evidence belong to the current assignment and attempt.
stages.outputs: An evidence-backed accept/reject decision for every gate check.
stages.exit_evidence: The supervisor is distinct from every producer. Failed or unverified checks return work to its owner and invalidate affected descendants.

stages.entry: The terminal result has been submitted after all accepted dependencies.
stages.outputs: The accepted integrated result, usage information and honest remaining limitations.
stages.exit_evidence: Every user acceptance criterion passes with inspected evidence. Peer evaluation is optional and cannot block delivery or upgrade simulated evidence.

required_evidence: The missing tool or access capability
Which work is stopped and whether its process is still active
exceptions.resolution: Restore and verify the capability before resume, or explicitly replan a qualified route. Do not penalize model skill for an environment failure.

required_evidence: The missing task/difficulty/skill support or confirmed model failure
A qualified replacement or explicitly authorized bounded trial
exceptions.resolution: Stop dispatch and reassess the route. An unpriced host binding can be replaced within the current pool after renewing its ability-fit reason. A frozen planned-route change needs a supervisor-reviewed replacement plan/run with failure history retained. Honor attempt and budget limits.

required_evidence: Declared or observed execution, startup and review costs/times
exceptions.resolution: Keep the plan at needs-evidence until estimates support the limit. Unknown cost is not zero; do not silently discard a user constraint.

required_evidence: A failed or unverified gate check
The required correction and affected outputs
exceptions.resolution: Reject the current packet with evidence. If integration exposes a component defect, the supervisor explicitly reopens that producing component so its downstream integration is invalidated; unaffected peers remain accepted. Renew ability-fit assignment before correction and stop at the retry ceiling.

required_evidence: Last known producer/process state and current artifacts
Evidence that prior execution is stopped or a resumable instance is identified
exceptions.resolution: Preserve the blocked reservation. Resume the same known execution, or reopen after confirming it stopped and bind the new attempt. A timeout alone never authorizes a duplicate launch.

required_evidence: The changed requirement or input snapshot
Affected components, integration results and acceptance criteria
exceptions.resolution: Reopen affected packets for changes within the frozen contract. Structural, acceptance or topology changes need an explicitly revised brief/run; preserve the old run and useful unaffected evidence.

resources.overhead: Use host-declared or measured startup, handoff and review estimates. Worker counts are ceilings; the route planner may select a smaller adequate pool. Replacement history remains visible.

topology.federation: Native or router routes may remain inside one agency. Cross-client work must first use the registered buyer/supplier contract and actual adapter preflight; this preset does not launch or contact another client.

limitations: Sources inform the workflow; they do not prove agent productivity.
The host decomposes the actual requirement and verifies tool/model identity and artifact contents.
The contract validator checks declared structure; meaningful acceptance and source claims still need review.
No live-model speedup, price, product deployment or multi-client readiness is established.
